snippet.title: TMNT: Splintered Fate - Platinum Edition Trailer
snippet.description: If you’ve been waiting for the perfect moment to dive into the world of Splintered Fate, this is it! We want to ensure there’s something for every type of player. For those looking for the absolute best value, keep an eye out for the brand-new Platinum Bundle on your favorite gaming platform. This comprehensive package includes all the paid content we've released to date, including Slash, Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam, Metalhead, Alopex, the Samurai armors, and every single free update! Buy now to take advantage of our launch offer.
